description: Image Description: A Delta Air Lines commercial airplane is captured in mid-flight, moments after takeoff or during landing, with its landing gear still extended. The aircraft, a narrow-body jet, features the airline's signature livery: a white fuselage with the red and blue Delta logo prominently displayed on the tail fin and the word "DELTA" written in bold red letters along the side of the plane. The registration number "N605DL" is visible near the front of the aircraft
